title: Independent F-MR30 Accepted Root-Uptake Attribution Receipt Qualification

branch_hygiene.reason: genuinely independent qualification must not use the F-MR30 owner branch as its source-history authority

candidate_acquisition: materialize only from exact pinned owner_candidate:candidate_path and verify git blob identity before compilation; candidate is not copied into qualification production source
qualification_rule: independent oracle and independent transaction model; owner tests are preservation evidence only
frozen_scope: one immutable root-extraction vector per outer candidate interval
prepared attribution is non-publishing worker/job-local scratch
public attribution requires successful generic accepted-commit receipt
attributed amount is reconciliation metadata and never a second mass booking
restricted serialized single-column real-physics orchestration semantics only
hard_negative_gates: a prepared attribution must not silently bind a different qrot vector than the one physically used to create the candidate
no attribution may publish without an accepted commit receipt
lineage, origin revision and interval identity must fail closed on mismatch
invalid/nonfinite/negative root forcing must fail closed
required_independent_checks_if_no_hard_g: zero, singleton, sparse, uneven, tiny and larger nonnegative qrot vectors
retry-driven accepted substeps with immutable qrot
numeric time-identity seam around the shared 64-epsilon rule
real canonical backend strict compile compatibility
early_exit_rule: any reproduced hard-negative fail-open closes F-VQ48 NOT_QUALIFIED; remaining matrix entries are UNRUN, not failed
nonclaims: dynamic qrot changes within one outer candidate interval
oxygen, salinity, frost, compensation, MICRO, Jong-van-Lier or macropore uptake
